anchor.key_ask: A business user can verify a pre-live intent and make a confident approve/reject call in under 2 minutes, unaided
anchor.demo_audience: Same client stakeholders who approved earlier backoffice rounds; convinced by approving one and rejecting one intent unaided
anchor.end_user: UAT testers: anyone except the submitter of the intent for approval
anchor.interaction_model: Two chatbots (current + pre-live), pre-live built first: changed-intents queue (New/Updated) is the hero -> click an intent -> test in the pre-live bot beside a What-changed card -> Pass/Fail; passed intents are grouped into a versioned release; current bot slot reserved as a v2 rail
